image_description: A low-angle shot of two intersecting street signs mounted on a weathered, cylindrical utility pole against a clear blue sky. The signs appear to be in a non-Latin script (possibly Thai or similar), with one sign being dark red/brown and the other green. The text on the signs appears distorted and illegible, characteristic of AI generation artifacts.

The signs exhibit a rusty, corroded texture that is inconsistent with standard modern street signage materials. The pole also has an unnatural, painted-on wood/metal hybrid texture.
The mounting mechanism is undefined. The signs appear to fuse into the pole without clear brackets or bolts, and the edges of the signs warp slightly near the attachment point.
